agent_responses.response_str:
Silver-tier benefits and cancellation-compensation rules vary by airline and route. I can’t verify booking 00C256’s carrier-specific policy from the tools available in this session, so I don’t want to overstate your eligibility.

Before contacting customer service, keep these points in mind:

- **Tier benefits are usually separate from legal compensation.** Silver status may provide priority support, standby/rebooking priority, waived fees, or bonus miles, but normally does not increase statutory compensation.
- **Ask for every remedy separately:** ticket refund or rerouting, legally required compensation, reimbursement of reasonable expenses, and any discretionary travel certificate or loyalty goodwill credit.
- **Cause and notice timing matter.** Eligibility often depends on why the flight was cancelled, when you were notified, the route, operating carrier, and whether acceptable alternate transportation was offered.
- **A certificate may not be the only option.** If the law entitles you to monetary compensation, accepting a voucher might involve restrictions or a waiver. Ask whether you may choose cash instead, and read the terms before accepting.
- **Confirm Silver-tier service recovery benefits.** Ask whether your status provides expedited handling, priority rebooking, fee waivers, mileage restoration, or an additional goodwill award.
- **Request restoration of used benefits.** If miles, an upgrade instrument, preferred-seat benefit, or other loyalty credit was attached to the cancelled booking, ask that it be redeposited without fees.
- **Document expenses and communications.** Retain itemized receipts, cancellation notices, screenshots, rebooking offers, and the time and reason given for cancellation.
- **Request written terms for any certificate:** value, expiration date, blackout dates, transferability, eligible fares, residual-value rules, and whether it can be combined with other credits.

A useful phrasing is:

“Please review booking 00C256 for all refund, rerouting, expense-reimbursement, statutory-compensation, and Silver-tier service-recovery benefits. Please identify the cancellation reason and applicable passenger-rights policy in writing. Before issuing a travel certificate, please confirm whether I may elect cash compensation and whether accepting the certificate waives any other rights.”
